title: Tirano Pay
subtitle: An AI fintech, Switzerland then Germany
note: Morvane, Quorvia and Tirano Pay are example names, not suggestions. The first two stand in for the real names screened in the run, so the findings are that run's answers. Every finding is an Antevo engine's answer on the date shown.

tries.label: The name, try by try

steps.label: Next steps for Tirano Pay, with the links

items.do: Check the name in the Swiss commercial register, then register the company
items.why: No Swiss company uses the name today; the register has the final word.

items.do: File the Swiss trademark in classes 36 and 42
items.why: The screen found no near mark; filing is what protects the name.

items.do: Then the EU trademark, before selling in Germany
items.why: Germany is the second market, and the Swiss mark does not reach it.
An unregistered domain can be taken by anyone at any time.
A screen is today only; the filing that matters is the one that lands next week.

sections.title: Market entry
sections.so_what: Germany comes second: it is growing while France shrinks.
evidence: German business activity at 55, its fastest growth in over four years; France at 46.2

sections.title: Costs
sections.verdict: Money is dearer in the euro area
sections.so_what: Budget for euro-area costs before selling in Germany.
evidence: Swiss policy rate 0% and euro area 2.5%, both as of October 2026

sections.title: Competition
sections.so_what: Zug is where the rivals, partners and investors sit.

evidence: Bonds, commodities and volatility are where market links are breaking
Funding is tighter as money rotates away from tech
The US ten-year yield held at 4.92%: the cost of money has not moved
On the radar: a December rate rise could come back into play

links.text: Two names fell on both registers at once: an identical mark and a Swiss company of the same name. The third was clear on both.
Demand is strongest in Germany, where money costs more than at home.
Markets are unsettled and funding for tech is tighter, so the length of the runway matters more than the timing of the round.
